Slovakia , [ c ] officially the ( First ) Slovak Republic , [ d ] [ 10 ] and from 14 March until 21 July 1939 officially known as the Slovak State ( Slovak : Slovenský štát ), [ 11 ] was a partially recognized client state of Nazi Germany which existed between 14 March 1939 and 4 April 1945 in Central Europe . [ e ] The Slovak part of Czechoslovakia declared independence with German support one day before the German occupation of Bohemia and Moravia . It controlled most of the territory of present-day Slovakia , without its current southern parts, which were ceded by Czechoslovakia to Hungary in 1938. It was the first formally independent Slovak state in history. Bratislava was the capital city.
